meta.title: Momentary Peace
meta.description: How much serenity can there be in a bombardment?

units.rawText: Time ticks slowly by, and Tony grows more and more anxious.
units.displayText: Time ticks slowly by, and Tony grows more and more anxious.

spans.text: Time ticks slowly by, and Tony grows more and more anxious.

units.rawText: Why aren't the Commander and Centaureissi here yet? I don't know how much this amount of ether will last...
units.displayText: Why aren't the Commander and Centaureissi here yet? I don't know how much this amount of ether will last...

spans.text: Why aren't the Commander and Centaureissi here yet? I don't know how much this amount of ether will last...

units.rawText: Do... do you think something happened to them?
units.displayText: Do... do you think something happened to them?

spans.text: Do... do you think something happened to them?

units.rawText: Chris' words interrupt Tony's uneasiness. He looks at the communicator in his hands and very nearly makes a call before finally deciding against it.
units.displayText: Chris' words interrupt Tony's uneasiness. He looks at the communicator in his hands and very nearly makes a call before finally deciding against it.

spans.text: Chris' words interrupt Tony's uneasiness. He looks at the communicator in his hands and very nearly makes a call before finally deciding against it.

units.rawText: I'm worried about them too, but we can't call them now. If they're hiding somewhere, it might end up being the death of them.
units.displayText: I'm worried about them too, but we can't call them now. If they're hiding somewhere, it might end up being the death of them.

spans.text: I'm worried about them too, but we can't call them now. If they're hiding somewhere, it might end up being the death of them.

units.rawText: But it's been so long...
units.displayText: But it's been so long...

spans.text: But it's been so long...

units.rawText: Shh—
units.displayText: Shh—

spans.text: Shh—

units.rawText: There are sounds of movement from outside the door. Tony and Chris stop talking and nervously listen to them.
units.displayText: There are sounds of movement from outside the door. Tony and Chris stop talking and nervously listen to them.

spans.text: There are sounds of movement from outside the door. Tony and Chris stop talking and nervously listen to them.

units.rawText: The Colonel told me to find that interrogator who missed morning assembly... Man, is he still in there?
units.displayText: The Colonel told me to find that interrogator who missed morning assembly... Man, is he still in there?

spans.text: The Colonel told me to find that interrogator who missed morning assembly... Man, is he still in there?

units.rawText: He should be. A patrol brought a kid in this morning for questioning.
units.displayText: He should be. A patrol brought a kid in this morning for questioning.

spans.text: He should be. A patrol brought a kid in this morning for questioning.

units.rawText: But considering he went in there with a bottle of beer... My guess is he fell asleep after torturing the kid.
units.displayText: But considering he went in there with a bottle of beer... My guess is he fell asleep after torturing the kid.

spans.text: But considering he went in there with a bottle of beer... My guess is he fell asleep after torturing the kid.

units.rawText: Dammit! If he did fall asleep, we're all screwed!
units.displayText: Dammit! If he did fall asleep, we're all screwed!

spans.text: Dammit! If he did fall asleep, we're all screwed!

units.rawText: Knock knock knock...
units.displayText: Knock knock knock...

spans.text: Knock knock knock...

units.rawText: The speaker knocks on the door.
units.displayText: The speaker knocks on the door.

spans.text: The speaker knocks on the door.

units.rawText: Sir?! Are you in there?
units.displayText: Sir?! Are you in there?

spans.text: Sir?! Are you in there?

units.rawText: Tony holds Chris tightly. He remains silent, starting at the door to the room.
units.displayText: Tony holds Chris tightly. He remains silent, starting at the door to the room.

spans.text: Tony holds Chris tightly. He remains silent, starting at the door to the room.

units.rawText: Stay quiet, Chris. They'll leave once they're sure there's nobody here...
units.displayText: Stay quiet, Chris. They'll leave once they're sure there's nobody here...

spans.text: Stay quiet, Chris. They'll leave once they're sure there's nobody here...

units.rawText: Kay...
units.displayText: Kay...

spans.text: Kay...

units.rawText: Sir! The Colonel's looking for you, please come to his office with us!
units.displayText: Sir! The Colonel's looking for you, please come to his office with us!

spans.text: Sir! The Colonel's looking for you, please come to his office with us!

units.rawText: Knock knock knock!
units.displayText: Knock knock knock!

spans.text: Knock knock knock!

units.rawText: The banging on the door grows louder and more frantic.
units.displayText: The banging on the door grows louder and more frantic.

spans.text: The banging on the door grows louder and more frantic.

units.rawText: Sir?!! If you don't head over now, the Colonel's going to get mad!!!
units.displayText: Sir?!! If you don't head over now, the Colonel's going to get mad!!!

spans.text: Sir?!! If you don't head over now, the Colonel's going to get mad!!!

units.rawText: There's no point, man. He's so drunk that there's no way he'll hear us and if he really doesn't want to go he'll just feign ignorance. It's not like you can do anything about it... Forget it, bro. Let's just go.
units.displayText: There's no point, man. He's so drunk that there's no way he'll hear us and if he really doesn't want to go he'll just feign ignorance. It's not like you can do anything about it... Forget it, bro. Let's just go.

spans.text: There's no point, man. He's so drunk that there's no way he'll hear us and if he really doesn't want to go he'll just feign ignorance. It's not like you can do anything about it... Forget it, bro. Let's just go.

units.rawText: (Spits) Disgusting drunk!
units.displayText: (Spits) Disgusting drunk!

spans.text: (Spits) Disgusting drunk!

units.rawText: Crash!
units.displayText: Crash!

spans.text: Crash!

units.rawText: The person outside kicks the door in frustration before leaving, hard enough that the wallpaper beside the metal door is jarred loose.
units.displayText: The person outside kicks the door in frustration before leaving, hard enough that the wallpaper beside the metal door is jarred loose.

spans.text: The person outside kicks the door in frustration before leaving, hard enough that the wallpaper beside the metal door is jarred loose.

units.rawText: The man lying unconscious in the interrogation room is awoken by the sudden noise. His head is aching, his body is numb, and he can barely move his arms.
units.displayText: The man lying unconscious in the interrogation room is awoken by the sudden noise. His head is aching, his body is numb, and he can barely move his arms.

spans.text: The man lying unconscious in the interrogation room is awoken by the sudden noise. His head is aching, his body is numb, and he can barely move his arms.

units.rawText: Tony moves quickly and presses the cloth on the man's face against his nose and mouth. But the ether is almost completely gone and it has little effect. As the man's head clears, he begins to struggle.
units.displayText: Tony moves quickly and presses the cloth on the man's face against his nose and mouth. But the ether is almost completely gone and it has little effect. As the man's head clears, he begins to struggle.

spans.text: Tony moves quickly and presses the cloth on the man's face against his nose and mouth. But the ether is almost completely gone and it has little effect. As the man's head clears, he begins to struggle.

units.rawText: <size=40>Mff— Mfffffff!!!</size>
units.displayText: Mff— Mfffffff!!!

spans.text: Mff— Mfffffff!!!

units.rawText: Thud!
units.displayText: Thud!

spans.text: Thud!

units.rawText: Their struggle knocks the chair and Tony's tool bag over. He even manages to knock the communicator on Tony's arm loose.
units.displayText: Their struggle knocks the chair and Tony's tool bag over. He even manages to knock the communicator on Tony's arm loose.

spans.text: Their struggle knocks the chair and Tony's tool bag over. He even manages to knock the communicator on Tony's arm loose.

units.rawText: The dull thuds break the previous silence and draw the attention of the soldiers who had almost left.
units.displayText: The dull thuds break the previous silence and draw the attention of the soldiers who had almost left.

spans.text: The dull thuds break the previous silence and draw the attention of the soldiers who had almost left.

units.rawText: <size=40>Something's wrong in the interrogation room!</size>
units.displayText: Something's wrong in the interrogation room!

spans.text: Something's wrong in the interrogation room!

units.rawText: Sir!! Are you in there?
units.displayText: Sir!! Are you in there?

spans.text: Sir!! Are you in there?

units.rawText: Step aside!
units.displayText: Step aside!

spans.text: Step aside!

units.rawText: Bangbangbang! He takes aim at the lock and fires, utterly destroying it.
units.displayText: Bangbangbang! He takes aim at the lock and fires, utterly destroying it.

spans.text: Bangbangbang! He takes aim at the lock and fires, utterly destroying it.

units.rawText: Crap! Chris, hide!
units.displayText: Crap! Chris, hide!

spans.text: Crap! Chris, hide!

units.rawText: Big Bro Tony!
units.displayText: Big Bro Tony!

spans.text: Big Bro Tony!

units.rawText: As Chris yells, the two soldiers burst in, pointing their guns at Tony, who's still struggling with the interrogator.
units.displayText: As Chris yells, the two soldiers burst in, pointing their guns at Tony, who's still struggling with the interrogator.

spans.text: As Chris yells, the two soldiers burst in, pointing their guns at Tony, who's still struggling with the interrogator.

units.rawText: And then, in the nick of time, a familiar face appears behind them.
units.displayText: And then, in the nick of time, a familiar face appears behind them.

spans.text: And then, in the nick of time, a familiar face appears behind them.

units.rawText: <size=40>Commander!</size>
units.displayText: Commander!

spans.text: Commander!

units.rawText: While the two soldiers are stunned by the sudden intrusion, I pop out from a blind spot in their vision and knock one of them out with a vicious strike to his neck.
units.displayText: While the two soldiers are stunned by the sudden intrusion, I pop out from a blind spot in their vision and knock one of them out with a vicious strike to his neck.

spans.text: While the two soldiers are stunned by the sudden intrusion, I pop out from a blind spot in their vision and knock one of them out with a vicious strike to his neck.

units.rawText: As the soldier keels backward, I kick him hard in the gut, sending him into his friend behind him and keeping him from bringing his weapon to bear.
units.displayText: As the soldier keels backward, I kick him hard in the gut, sending him into his friend behind him and keeping him from bringing his weapon to bear.

spans.text: As the soldier keels backward, I kick him hard in the gut, sending him into his friend behind him and keeping him from bringing his weapon to bear.

units.rawText: The other man is stunned briefly as the back of his head bounces off the ground; I punch him hard on the bridge of the nose three times, ensuring he won't be waking up anytime soon.
units.displayText: The other man is stunned briefly as the back of his head bounces off the ground; I punch him hard on the bridge of the nose three times, ensuring he won't be waking up anytime soon.

spans.text: The other man is stunned briefly as the back of his head bounces off the ground; I punch him hard on the bridge of the nose three times, ensuring he won't be waking up anytime soon.

units.rawText: Seeing as Tony is still engaged in his own struggle, I grab the bottle of champagne on the table and bring it down on the interrogator's head, sending him to dreamland.
units.displayText: Seeing as Tony is still engaged in his own struggle, I grab the bottle of champagne on the table and bring it down on the interrogator's head, sending him to dreamland.

spans.text: Seeing as Tony is still engaged in his own struggle, I grab the bottle of champagne on the table and bring it down on the interrogator's head, sending him to dreamland.

units.rawText: Commander... that was a pretty expensive bottle of champagne...
units.displayText: Commander... that was a pretty expensive bottle of champagne...

spans.text: Commander... that was a pretty expensive bottle of champagne...

units.rawText: Still... Thanks for the help, Commander.
units.displayText: Still... Thanks for the help, Commander.

spans.text: Still... Thanks for the help, Commander.

units.rawText: Can you move?
units.displayText: Can you move?

spans.text: Can you move?

units.rawText: I reach out to help Tony up just as Centaureissi arrives.
units.displayText: I reach out to help Tony up just as Centaureissi arrives.

spans.text: I reach out to help Tony up just as Centaureissi arrives.

units.rawText: Commander, I've investigated as you asked.
units.displayText: Commander, I've investigated as you asked.

spans.text: Commander, I've investigated as you asked.

units.rawText: These soldiers... Did you deal with them, Commander?
units.displayText: These soldiers... Did you deal with them, Commander?

spans.text: These soldiers... Did you deal with them, Commander?

units.rawText: ...Yeah. Looks like I haven't gotten rusty yet.
units.displayText: ...Yeah. Looks like I haven't gotten rusty yet.

spans.text: ...Yeah. Looks like I haven't gotten rusty yet.

units.rawText: Where's Chris?
units.displayText: Where's Chris?

spans.text: Where's Chris?

units.rawText: Just as I say that, a little head pops out from under the table.
units.displayText: Just as I say that, a little head pops out from under the table.

spans.text: Just as I say that, a little head pops out from under the table.

units.rawText: Commander, Big Sis Centaureissi... I'm here...
units.displayText: Commander, Big Sis Centaureissi... I'm here...

spans.text: Commander, Big Sis Centaureissi... I'm here...

units.rawText: Centaureissi pulls Chris over and quickly inspects his body. Fortunately, he's fine beyond the bruise from being bashed on the neck.
units.displayText: Centaureissi pulls Chris over and quickly inspects his body. Fortunately, he's fine beyond the bruise from being bashed on the neck.

spans.text: Centaureissi pulls Chris over and quickly inspects his body. Fortunately, he's fine beyond the bruise from being bashed on the neck.

units.rawText: That interrogator didn't do anything to you, did he? Does it hurt anywhere?
units.displayText: That interrogator didn't do anything to you, did he? Does it hurt anywhere?

spans.text: That interrogator didn't do anything to you, did he? Does it hurt anywhere?

units.rawText: The look in Centaureissi's eyes is kind, and as Chris thinks about how he's caused so much trouble for everyone, the guilt overwhelms him and his eyes fill with tears.
units.displayText: The look in Centaureissi's eyes is kind, and as Chris thinks about how he's caused so much trouble for everyone, the guilt overwhelms him and his eyes fill with tears.

spans.text: The look in Centaureissi's eyes is kind, and as Chris thinks about how he's caused so much trouble for everyone, the guilt overwhelms him and his eyes fill with tears.

units.rawText: I... I'm sorry, everyone...
units.displayText: I... I'm sorry, everyone...

spans.text: I... I'm sorry, everyone...

units.rawText: You don't have to apologize now. This place isn't safe; let's talk elsewhere.
units.displayText: You don't have to apologize now. This place isn't safe; let's talk elsewhere.

spans.text: You don't have to apologize now. This place isn't safe; let's talk elsewhere.

units.rawText: Mm... yeah!
units.displayText: Mm... yeah!

spans.text: Mm... yeah!

units.rawText: Beside him, Tony quickly picks up his hairdressing implements.
units.displayText: Beside him, Tony quickly picks up his hairdressing implements.

spans.text: Beside him, Tony quickly picks up his hairdressing implements.

units.rawText: Centaureissi, help me pick this stuff up! They're more precious than my life, I can't let them be lost here!
units.displayText: Centaureissi, help me pick this stuff up! They're more precious than my life, I can't let them be lost here!

spans.text: Centaureissi, help me pick this stuff up! They're more precious than my life, I can't let them be lost here!

units.rawText: ...Understood.
units.displayText: ...Understood.

spans.text: ...Understood.

units.rawText: The blond girl nods and gets busy too. As she puts them back in their place, she notices the papers and pens on the table out of the corner of her eye.
units.displayText: The blond girl nods and gets busy too. As she puts them back in their place, she notices the papers and pens on the table out of the corner of her eye.

spans.text: The blond girl nods and gets busy too. As she puts them back in their place, she notices the papers and pens on the table out of the corner of her eye.

units.rawText: She was a kind and sympathetic girl, and she always treated me as part of the family, even going so far as to call me her big sister.
units.displayText: She was a kind and sympathetic girl, and she always treated me as part of the family, even going so far as to call me her big sister.

spans.text: She was a kind and sympathetic girl, and she always treated me as part of the family, even going so far as to call me her big sister.

units.rawText: Vayne loved... she loved drawing. She would drag me to art exhibitions from a young age, where she would enjoy works from various artists.
units.displayText: Vayne loved... she loved drawing. She would drag me to art exhibitions from a young age, where she would enjoy works from various artists.

spans.text: Vayne loved... she loved drawing. She would drag me to art exhibitions from a young age, where she would enjoy works from various artists.

units.rawText: Ah, I like drawing too.
units.displayText: Ah, I like drawing too.

spans.text: Ah, I like drawing too.

units.rawText: Hehe, sounds like you and Vayne would have become friends if you'd met.
units.displayText: Hehe, sounds like you and Vayne would have become friends if you'd met.

spans.text: Hehe, sounds like you and Vayne would have become friends if you'd met.

units.rawText: Commander, I'd like to take these things with me, if it's possible...
units.displayText: Commander, I'd like to take these things with me, if it's possible...

spans.text: Commander, I'd like to take these things with me, if it's possible...

units.rawText: After much running and hiding, we finally make it back to the safehouse outside the city.
units.displayText: After much running and hiding, we finally make it back to the safehouse outside the city.

spans.text: After much running and hiding, we finally make it back to the safehouse outside the city.

units.rawText: ...However, that's what puzzles me.
units.displayText: ...However, that's what puzzles me.

spans.text: ...However, that's what puzzles me.

units.rawText: We spotted the enemies pursuing us several times along the way, but the strange thing is that nobody intercepted us. Even the safehouse's miniature radar didn't pick up anything fishy.
units.displayText: We spotted the enemies pursuing us several times along the way, but the strange thing is that nobody intercepted us. Even the safehouse's miniature radar didn't pick up anything fishy.

spans.text: We spotted the enemies pursuing us several times along the way, but the strange thing is that nobody intercepted us. Even the safehouse's miniature radar didn't pick up anything fishy.

units.rawText: Commander... Something's not right. Our escape went too well...
units.displayText: Commander... Something's not right. Our escape went too well...

spans.text: Commander... Something's not right. Our escape went too well...

units.rawText: Yeah, I think so too. There's no way the enemy didn't notice what happened in the interrogation room after so long.
units.displayText: Yeah, I think so too. There's no way the enemy didn't notice what happened in the interrogation room after so long.

spans.text: Yeah, I think so too. There's no way the enemy didn't notice what happened in the interrogation room after so long.

units.rawText: Centaureissi indicates the radar image.
units.displayText: Centaureissi indicates the radar image.

spans.text: Centaureissi indicates the radar image.

units.rawText: There's no change in the enemy numbers of their patrol routes... Not only that, they didn't send any messages to their friends in the city either...
units.displayText: There's no change in the enemy numbers of their patrol routes... Not only that, they didn't send any messages to their friends in the city either...

spans.text: There's no change in the enemy numbers of their patrol routes... Not only that, they didn't send any messages to their friends in the city either...

units.rawText: If they didn't do anything, then the enemy's up to something. We can't relax while the situation is still unclear.
units.displayText: If they didn't do anything, then the enemy's up to something. We can't relax while the situation is still unclear.

spans.text: If they didn't do anything, then the enemy's up to something. We can't relax while the situation is still unclear.

units.rawText: Don't worry, Commander. I'll keep an eye on the safehouse's surroundings. If this location is exposed, we can relocate up the mountain ASAP.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Commander. I'll keep an eye on the safehouse's surroundings. If this location is exposed, we can relocate up the mountain ASAP.

spans.text: Don't worry, Commander. I'll keep an eye on the safehouse's surroundings. If this location is exposed, we can relocate up the mountain ASAP.

units.rawText: ...Yeah. We should focus on the more important things instead. Oh yes, about Chris' injuries...
units.displayText: ...Yeah. We should focus on the more important things instead. Oh yes, about Chris' injuries...

spans.text: ...Yeah. We should focus on the more important things instead. Oh yes, about Chris' injuries...

units.rawText: Mm, let me take care of them. Come here, Chris.
units.displayText: Mm, let me take care of them. Come here, Chris.

spans.text: Mm, let me take care of them. Come here, Chris.

units.rawText: He nervously walks up to Centaureissi. The uniformed maid has a keen look in her eyes and a stern look on her face as she raises her hand.
units.displayText: He nervously walks up to Centaureissi. The uniformed maid has a keen look in her eyes and a stern look on her face as she raises her hand.

spans.text: He nervously walks up to Centaureissi. The uniformed maid has a keen look in her eyes and a stern look on her face as she raises her hand.

units.rawText: Chris knows that his rashness put everyone in danger, and he closes his eyes as he awaits his punishment.
units.displayText: Chris knows that his rashness put everyone in danger, and he closes his eyes as he awaits his punishment.

spans.text: Chris knows that his rashness put everyone in danger, and he closes his eyes as he awaits his punishment.

units.rawText: But the slap he expects does not come. Instead, the cool sensation of ointment being applied comes from his wound and soothes his pain.
units.displayText: But the slap he expects does not come. Instead, the cool sensation of ointment being applied comes from his wound and soothes his pain.

spans.text: But the slap he expects does not come. Instead, the cool sensation of ointment being applied comes from his wound and soothes his pain.

units.rawText: Big Sis... Centaureissi?
units.displayText: Big Sis... Centaureissi?

spans.text: Big Sis... Centaureissi?

units.rawText: Good, there's no damage to the muscle or bones. It's just an ordinary bruise, so you should get better after applying the ointment.
units.displayText: Good, there's no damage to the muscle or bones. It's just an ordinary bruise, so you should get better after applying the ointment.

spans.text: Good, there's no damage to the muscle or bones. It's just an ordinary bruise, so you should get better after applying the ointment.

units.rawText: You're not going to punish me?
units.displayText: You're not going to punish me?

spans.text: You're not going to punish me?

units.rawText: ...Why would I punish you? It's only natural for you to miss your father.
units.displayText: ...Why would I punish you? It's only natural for you to miss your father.

spans.text: ...Why would I punish you? It's only natural for you to miss your father.

units.rawText: I found this in the interrogation room. I guess you went back to the city to retrieve it.
units.displayText: I found this in the interrogation room. I guess you went back to the city to retrieve it.

spans.text: I found this in the interrogation room. I guess you went back to the city to retrieve it.

units.rawText: Is that... my father's medal?
units.displayText: Is that... my father's medal?

spans.text: Is that... my father's medal?

units.rawText: Don't lose it, okay?
units.displayText: Don't lose it, okay?

spans.text: Don't lose it, okay?

units.rawText: Chris can't keep up his facade of strength anymore. He collapses into Centaureissi's arms and weeps into her chest.
units.displayText: Chris can't keep up his facade of strength anymore. He collapses into Centaureissi's arms and weeps into her chest.

spans.text: Chris can't keep up his facade of strength anymore. He collapses into Centaureissi's arms and weeps into her chest.

units.rawText: (Sobs) Dad... Dad...
units.displayText: (Sobs) Dad... Dad...

spans.text: (Sobs) Dad... Dad...

units.rawText: Tony moves up behind Chris and gently pats him on the back in a soothing way.
units.displayText: Tony moves up behind Chris and gently pats him on the back in a soothing way.

spans.text: Tony moves up behind Chris and gently pats him on the back in a soothing way.

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka's greatest wish was to take you to see that patch of daisies when they bloomed.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka's greatest wish was to take you to see that patch of daisies when they bloomed.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka's greatest wish was to take you to see that patch of daisies when they bloomed.

units.rawText: That was where he met your mother, and also when his happiness began.
units.displayText: That was where he met your mother, and also when his happiness began.

spans.text: That was where he met your mother, and also when his happiness began.

units.rawText: ...Since he entrusted you to me, then I'll help make his wish of taking you to see the daisies come true.
units.displayText: ...Since he entrusted you to me, then I'll help make his wish of taking you to see the daisies come true.

spans.text: ...Since he entrusted you to me, then I'll help make his wish of taking you to see the daisies come true.

units.rawText: So don't run off by yourself again, okay?
units.displayText: So don't run off by yourself again, okay?

spans.text: So don't run off by yourself again, okay?

units.rawText: (Sniffle) Okay...
units.displayText: (Sniffle) Okay...

spans.text: (Sniffle) Okay...

units.rawText: Chris, I have something for you.
units.displayText: Chris, I have something for you.

spans.text: Chris, I have something for you.

units.rawText: Centaureissi takes the pen and papers she took from the camp and places it in his hands.
units.displayText: Centaureissi takes the pen and papers she took from the camp and places it in his hands.

spans.text: Centaureissi takes the pen and papers she took from the camp and places it in his hands.

units.rawText: W-What's this?
units.displayText: W-What's this?

spans.text: W-What's this?

units.rawText: You told me you like drawing earlier, so I got this for you before we left the enemy camp.
units.displayText: You told me you like drawing earlier, so I got this for you before we left the enemy camp.

spans.text: You told me you like drawing earlier, so I got this for you before we left the enemy camp.

units.rawText: Centaureissi dabs away the tears on Chris' face as she explains herself.
units.displayText: Centaureissi dabs away the tears on Chris' face as she explains herself.

spans.text: Centaureissi dabs away the tears on Chris' face as she explains herself.

units.rawText: Vayne once told me that drawings can describe different feelings from words.
units.displayText: Vayne once told me that drawings can describe different feelings from words.

spans.text: Vayne once told me that drawings can describe different feelings from words.

units.rawText: If there's anything you want to tell the Lieutenant, perhaps you could try putting it in picture form.
units.displayText: If there's anything you want to tell the Lieutenant, perhaps you could try putting it in picture form.

spans.text: If there's anything you want to tell the Lieutenant, perhaps you could try putting it in picture form.

units.rawText: Chris accepts the paper and recalls his father's face.
units.displayText: Chris accepts the paper and recalls his father's face.

spans.text: Chris accepts the paper and recalls his father's face.

units.rawText: Come on, give me a smile, my little daisy.
units.displayText: Come on, give me a smile, my little daisy.

spans.text: Come on, give me a smile, my little daisy.

units.rawText: Dad...
units.displayText: Dad...

spans.text: Dad...
